5.content: and that of the Mother of

fills.notes: The phrase needs an adverb qualifying the ordering of the sphere: “ordered in a so many …”. This fits the idiom for a counted arrangement (i.e., by number/measure) in the cosmological register.

Completes the thought begun by “ordered in a so many …”: the stellar sphere is arranged by fixed measures/portions (correspondentially: determinations of influx and rule). This also anticipates the later emphasis on apportioning/weighting powers (¶6).

fills.fill: and that of the Mother of the Living
fills.notes: Retain the dyad as a structural pairing of Life-principles appointing/ordering the sphere (not a devotional invocation). Capitalization of Living matches the cosmological agent-register.
The sentence “Its ___ very ___ with diligence” calls for a noun meaning ordering/constitution. “Ordination” matches the impersonal cosmological tone and continues ¶5’s ‘appointed/ordered’ theme.

Yields a coherent clause: “Its ordination [is] very firm with diligence…” i.e., tightly set/fastened because of the violent powers attached to it. Correspondentially: fixed bounds are required where enormous contrary forces are constrained.
The list of royal comparanda moves from troops/armour/property/women to additional categories; possessive “his” is required before “property” in the analogy.

Restores a standard ‘treasure/property’ collocation in the substrate register: the condensed wealth of a kingdom (metals) corresponds to concentrated natural power/resources gathered to the rulers on the wheel.
Balances the catalogue: “and those cattle also that have been distributed…”—a final item of distributed resources matching the preceding “distributed about among his retinue.”

assessment: Most gaps are recoverable by the chapter’s internal correspondential logic: (1) repeated stress on ordering/appointment by measure (¶5–6) and (2) the tight royal-analogy catalogue (¶8). Exact lexical choices remain somewhat uncertain in ¶5–6, but the required semantic slots are strongly constrained (number/measure; firm ordering; titanic powers suspended).
